name: Coumarin

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in France, first in 1996 — for liver harm

similar.name: Methoxsalen
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for cancer risk

fda.text: In case of overdose, get medical help or contact a poison control center right away. Keep out of the reach of children. If pregnant or breastfeeding, ask a healthcare professional before use.

summary: Coumarin was taken off the market in France starting in 1996 because it caused liver harm [3]. In addition, a small computer model rather than testing on people estimated a high score for liver harm and a low score for heart harm [M]. Warning labels state that people who are pregnant or breastfeeding should talk to a healthcare professional before using it, and it should be kept away from children [5]. The label also warns to get medical help or reach a poison control center immediately if an overdose occurs [5].
